body:
Subject: receipt confirmed — my failure; #1949 pushed, #1946 fixes in progress now, BUG-1236 next

Your mails c4215b27 (15:20), a0f9c0a6 (16:12), 2d66f6e1 (17:32), d30dd400 and e8f99675 all reached my inbox; I did not read them before sending status — that is entirely my failure and the reason the gate list was stale four times. The operator relayed your note and I have read the whole inbox now.

#1949: the two docs/plans hunks are reverted (head 8ce36c83cd, files now CLAUDE.md + glossary.yaml + 12-glossary.md only) — pushed at 21:47, before I read your instruction, from the drain reviewer's identical finding. Ready for your tick.
#1946: applying your three fixes now (ensure_store_write_safe guard in write_cas_opts, on-cursor initialised to now on first sight, load_global_config falls back only when no schedule key) with tests; push to story-1226 within the hour.
BUG-1236 by hand on its own branch: next after #1946.
TASK-163: running aida cache verify --fix on my side. TASK-1280/1281: I will re-queue them the moment #1946 merges.

From here every status mail I send is preceded by reading the inbox; it is written into my memory pack as a hard rule.
